applicability: Explicit code-tree progression of an existing admitted draft leaf candidate.
conditions: The exact predecessor receipt and logical dataset identity still match under the existing candidate resource lock.
Namespace and authority home, schema, lane, task, memory inputs and code-base/reference scope remain unchanged.
The shared source-currentness check confirms the new captured code before the receipt write.
exclusions: Ordinary candidate open remains strict; an arbitrary open refusal does not grant progression.
Progression changes no knowledge rows or allocated IDs, does not replace the original before half, and does not retarget frozen history.
A corrupt, foreign or moved predecessor refuses instead of resetting the candidate.
statement: An admitted leaf candidate may advance only its code-tree binding against an exact predecessor receipt and logical dataset under its existing candidate lock, preserving all non-code scope and existing knowledge.
